description:
We’re getting ready for the NASA Space Apps Challenge! 🚀 Our team is working on "Abandoned but not Forgotten," using NASA’s open data, AI/ML, Web Development, Data Analysis, UI/UX, and Creative Storytelling to bring the history of NASA's Moon and Mars equipment to life. 🌕🔴 We’re looking for passionate teammates in research, tech, design, and presentation to join us, collaborate, and create something meaningful together. If you're excited to build an innovative space solution, drop a message and let's team up!

Join Team AstroForge!
